topic: A homeowner discovers previous residents left items in the attic
text: As I climbed the creaking ladder into the attic, the air grew thick, clinging to my skin like an unseen shroud. Dust motes danced in the slivers of light, but it was the quiet that struck me — a heavy, watching silence. Each step I took seemed to echo louder, despite the dusty floor barely shifting under my weight. There, in the corner, a faded wooden trunk. I hesitated, my hand hovering over the latch, the air around me pressing in. The handles were cold, the wood worn smooth. I lifted the lid slowly, the scent of old paper and forgotten things wafting up. Inside, rows of meticulously folded clothes, a child’s drawing pinned carefully to the underside of the lid, a diary with a tarnished lock. It felt intrusive, peering into the shadows of lives I didn’t know, each item a silent testament to a past I couldn’t fully grasp, didn’t want to disturb.
